info.description: Your Phoenix Perpetuals accounts from your own code: accounts, live risk, positions, orders, fills and history.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: It filled, was canceled or ended before your request (details.status).
x-pp-error-codes.action: Read the order to see its state.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The same key came with a different body.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Use a new Idempotency-Key for a new action.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: A retry came while the first was not finished.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Retry after the Retry-After header.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The key is limited to some markets (details.markets).
x-pp-error-codes.action: Use a key that may trade it, or change the key's markets.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The key is reduce-only: every order it places must be reduce_only.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Set reduce_only, or use another key.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The key has a largest order value (details.max_order_usd).
x-pp-error-codes.action: Place a smaller order.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The key has a largest position value (details.max_position_usd).
x-pp-error-codes.action: Place a smaller order.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: Trading with the key is stopped on the account until the next trading day.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Wait for the next trading day (details.unlocks_at).

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The order needs more margin than is available (details).
x-pp-error-codes.action: Place a smaller order, lower the leverage, or close positions.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: Your open value on a market, across your accounts of the same product, is capped.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Place a smaller order.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: A reduce-only order may only reduce or close a position.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Check the position's side and size.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The best price was beyond worst_price (or max_slippage_pct) when the order arrived.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Allow more slippage, or use a limit order.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The market has no price to fill against yet.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Retry after the Retry-After header.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The latest price is too old to trade against.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Retry after the Retry-After header.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The market does not trade now.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Try again when it opens.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The market is not offered for new positions.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Choose another market.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: Trading in the market is stopped for now.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Try again later.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: A position in liquidation takes no new order.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Wait until it is closed.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: A trading rule paused the account (details.until when known).
x-pp-error-codes.action: Wait until it resumes.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The account passed, failed, or was closed (details.reason).
x-pp-error-codes.action: Use another account.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The account balance does not cover this.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Reduce the order.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: A position or working order is open on the market.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Close them, then change the mode.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: Leverage is a whole number from 1 to the market's max_leverage (details).
x-pp-error-codes.action: Choose a leverage within it.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The change would move the liquidation price beyond the market.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Choose a lower leverage or keep more margin.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: Only an isolated position has its own margin to change.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Switch the market to isolated first.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The engine is under load and took nothing.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Retry after the Retry-After header.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The engine refused the order for a reason without its own code.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Check the order, or contact support with the request id.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The position or its take-profit and stop-loss legs are not the ones your request was built on (a fill, a trim, another call).
x-pp-error-codes.action: Build the batch again from details.exits, which is the state now.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The engine refused one operation part way through the batch.
x-pp-error-codes.action: details.results says what each operation did and details.exits what is in place now.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: A take-profit must be on the profit side of the last price: above it for a long position, below it for a short one.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Use a price beyond the last price, or close the position instead.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The take-profit legs together, or the stop-loss legs together, would be more than the position.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Make each group at most the position size (details.position_size).

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: A position holds a limited number of take-profit and of stop-loss legs.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Cancel or merge a leg first (details.max).

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: A limit on running strategies or resting legs was reached (details.scope).
x-pp-error-codes.action: End or cancel a strategy first.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: Only a waiting or working strategy can be canceled.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Read it again: its status and end_reason say how it ended.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The id is unknown, or belongs to another account or environment.
x-pp-error-codes.action: List the account's strategies to find it.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: Your id for a strategy is unique in its environment.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Use another id, or read the existing one (details.strategy_id).

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The id is unknown, or belongs to another customer or environment.
x-pp-error-codes.action: List your endpoints to find it.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The id is unknown, revoked, or belongs to another customer or environment.
x-pp-error-codes.action: List your TradingView links to find it.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The id is unknown, or older than the alert log keeps.
x-pp-error-codes.action: List the link's alerts to find it.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: Tests and resends go to active endpoints only.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Turn it on again (enable, or your dashboard), then try again.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The id is unknown, or older than the delivery log keeps.
x-pp-error-codes.action: List the endpoint's deliveries to find it.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The id is unknown, or older than the event log keeps.
x-pp-error-codes.action: List the events (GET /v1/events) to find it.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: A limit of a scaled order is through the last price, so it would fill at once instead of resting.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Move the ladder away from the price, or send allow_marketable true.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The strategy type is switched off on the platform.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Use another type, or try again later.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The account does not exist in this environment, or the key does not reach it.
x-pp-error-codes.action: List your accounts with GET /v1/accounts.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The market is not offered.
x-pp-error-codes.action: List the markets with GET /v1/markets.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The order is not on this account.
x-pp-error-codes.action: List the account's orders.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The account holds nothing on that market now.
x-pp-error-codes.action: List the open positions.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The path does not exist on this host.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Check the path against the reference.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The path exists, with other methods (see the Allow header).
x-pp-error-codes.action: Use a method the Allow header lists.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The body is over the size limit.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Send a smaller body.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The URL is over the length limit.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Shorten the query.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: A body was sent without Content-Type: application/json.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Send JSON with that header.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: Each customer may open a fixed number of sandbox accounts, ever.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Keep using the ones you have.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The account exists but is not open on the trading engine yet.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Retry after the Retry-After header.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The account was reserved and is being opened.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Retry after the Retry-After header.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: Calls that create something need a key that makes a retry safe.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Send Idempotency-Key with a new unique value per action.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The key is empty, too long, or has characters it cannot.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Send 1 to 128 printable characters.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: A request budget is used up (details.scope says which).
x-pp-error-codes.action: Wait for Retry-After, then spread your requests.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The API is starting and has not loaded your keys yet.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Retry after the Retry-After header.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The trading engine did not give a complete answer in time; nothing partial is returned.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Retry after the Retry-After header.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The trading engine did not answer.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Retry after the Retry-After header.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The rate limiter is unavailable, so nothing passes unmeasured.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Retry after the Retry-After header.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: Sandbox accounts are not being opened.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Try again later.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: This host takes no requests at the moment.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Check GET /v1/status.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: A service this call needs did not answer.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Retry after the Retry-After header.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: The API is busy.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Retry after the Retry-After header.

x-pp-error-codes.meaning: An error we did not expect.
x-pp-error-codes.action: Retry; if it lasts, contact support with the request id.
